description: Noeud de fibre du réseau haut débit "CUB-DSI" sur le territoire de Bordeaux Métropole is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by pigma.org. This punctual dataset provides information on the points of convergence (nodes) of the lines that make up the internal broadband network in Bordeaux Métropole. This network concerns only certain metropolitan buildings. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Fibre node of the broadband network "CUB-DSI" on the territory of Bordeaux Métropole" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspire, infrastructures, RT_PLCUB_P, fibre optique, RT_PLCUB, réseaux. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
